responses.text: Some convicts from the prison up the road have taken over the town. Everyone inside is either dead or in hiding.
What's more, there are two tribes of raiders causing trouble in this area as well. You'd be safer heading back up to Goodsprings.
It's your ass. Don't say you weren't warned.

topics.prompt: I can take care of myself.

responses.text: Be careful. You may want to talk to Lieutenant Hayes.
He's in a tent down the road. Just stay on the west side of the overpass if you don't want to get shot.
We'd love to, but they don't fall under NCR jurisdiction. Even if they did we're in no shape to protect them.

topics.prompt: Shouldn't you be protecting the town or something?

responses.text: We don't have the equipment to take out the convicts, and even if we did we need some extra hands for backup.
You should talk to Lieutenant Hayes. He's in a tent down the road. Just stay on the west side of the overpass if you don't want to get shot.
